verses.original: וַיַּקְהֵ֣ל דָּוִ֣יד אֶת־ כָּל־ שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל שָׂרֵ֣י הַשְּׁבָטִ֣ים וְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמַּחְלְק֣וֹת הַמְשָׁרְתִ֪ים אֶת־ הַמֶּ֟לֶךְ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֲלָפִ֣ים וְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֡וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י כָל־ רְכוּשׁ־ וּמִקְנֶה֩׀ לַמֶּ֨לֶךְ וּלְבָנָ֜יו עִם־ הַסָּרִיסִ֧ים וְהַגִּבּוֹרִ֛ים וּֽלְכָל־ גִּבּ֥וֹר חָ֖יִל אֶל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·hêl dā·wîḏ ’eṯ- kāl- śā·rê yiś·rā·’êl śā·rê haš·šə·ḇā·ṭîm wə·śā·rê ham·maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ ham·šā·rə·ṯîm ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ wə·śā·rê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·śā·rê ham·mê·’ō·wṯ wə·śā·rê ḵāl rə·ḵūš- ū·miq·neh lam·me·leḵ ū·lə·ḇā·nāw ‘im- has·sā·rî·sîm wə·hag·gib·bō·w·rîm ū·lə·ḵāl- gib·bō·wr ḥā·yil ’el- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Now David summoned all the leaders of Israel to Jerusalem the leaders of the tribes the leaders of the divisions in the king’s service the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and the officials in charge of all the property and cattle of the king and his sons along with the court officials and mighty men every mighty man of valor
verses.literalPt: Convocou Davi, em Jerusalém, todos os príncipes de Israel, os príncipes das tribos, os capitães das turmas que serviam o rei, os capitães de mil, os capitães de cem, os intendentes de toda a fazenda e possessões do rei e de seus filhos, juntamente com os oficiais e homens poderosos, a saber, todos os ilustres em valor.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קָם דָּוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ רַגְלָ֔יו וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שְׁמָע֖וּנִי אַחַ֣י וְעַמִּ֑י אֲנִ֣י עִם־ לְבָבִ֡י לִבְנוֹת֩ בֵּ֨ית מְנוּחָ֜ה לַאֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֗ה וְלַהֲדֹם֙ רַגְלֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וַהֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לִבְנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām dā·wîḏ ham·me·leḵ ‘al- raḡ·lāw way·yō·mer šə·mā·‘ū·nî ’a·ḥay wə·‘am·mî ’ă·nî ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇî liḇ·nō·wṯ bêṯ mə·nū·ḥāh la·’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh wə·la·hă·ḏōm raḡ·lê ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wa·hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯî liḇ·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then King David rose to his feet and said Listen to me my brothers and my people . . . It was in my heart to build a house as a resting place for the ark of the covenant of the LORD and as a footstool . . . for our God I had made preparations to build it
verses.literalPt: Então, se pôs o rei Davi em pé e disse: Ouvi-me, irmãos meus e povo meu. Era minha intenção edificar casa de repouso para a arca da Aliança de Jeová e para o escabelo dos pés de nosso Deus; e me achava pronto para a construção.

verses.original: וְהָאֱלֹהִים֙ אָ֣מַר לִ֔י לֹא־ תִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֖יִת לִשְׁמִ֑י כִּ֣י אִ֧ישׁ מִלְחָמ֛וֹת אַ֖תָּה וְדָמִ֥ים שָׁפָֽכְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ā·mar lî lō- ṯiḇ·neh ḇa·yiṯ liš·mî kî ’îš mil·ḥā·mō·wṯ ’at·tāh wə·ḏā·mîm šā·p̄ā·ḵə·tā
verses.literal: but God said to me You are not to build a house for My Name because you are a man of war who has shed blood
verses.literalPt: Porém Deus me disse: Não edificarás casa ao meu nome, porque és homem de guerra e tens derramado sangue.

verses.original: וַיִּבְחַ֡ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל בִּ֜י מִכֹּ֣ל בֵּית־ אָבִ֗י לִהְי֨וֹת לְמֶ֤לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְעוֹלָ֔ם כִּ֤י בִֽיהוּדָה֙ בָּחַ֣ר לְנָגִ֔יד וּבְבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י וּבִבְנֵ֣י אָבִ֔י בִּ֣י רָצָ֔ה לְהַמְלִ֖יךְ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl bî mik·kōl bêṯ- ’ā·ḇî lih·yō·wṯ lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl lə·‘ō·w·lām kî ḇî·hū·ḏāh bā·ḥar lə·nā·ḡîḏ ū·ḇə·ḇêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh bêṯ ’ā·ḇî ū·ḇiḇ·nê ’ā·ḇî bî rā·ṣāh lə·ham·lîḵ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Yet the LORD the God of Israel chose me out of all my father’s house to be king over Israel forever For He chose Judah as leader and from the house of Judah He chose my father’s household and from my father’s . . . sons He was pleased to make me king over all Israel
verses.literalPt: Todavia, Jeová, Deus de Israel, me escolheu de toda a casa de meu pai para ser eu rei sobre Israel para sempre, porque a Judá escolheu por príncipe; na casa de Judá, escolheu a casa de meu pai e, entre os filhos de meu pai, agradou-se de mim para me fazer rei sobre todo o Israel;

verses.original: וּמִכָּ֨ל־ בָּנַ֔י כִּ֚י רַבִּ֣ים בָּנִ֔ים נָ֥תַן לִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּבְחַר֙ בִּשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֔י לָשֶׁ֗בֶת עַל־ כִּסֵּ֛א מַלְכ֥וּת יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mik·kāl- bā·nay kî rab·bîm bā·nîm nā·ṯan lî Yah·weh way·yiḇ·ḥar biš·lō·mōh ḇə·nî lā·še·ḇeṯ ‘al- kis·sê mal·ḵūṯ Yah·weh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And of all my sons for the LORD has given me many sons He has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel
verses.literalPt: e, de todos os meus filhos (porque Jeová me deu muitos filhos), escolheu ele a meu filho Salomão para se assentar no trono do reino de Jeová, sobre Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לִ֔י שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בִנְךָ֔ הֽוּא־ יִבְנֶ֥ה בֵיתִ֖י וַחֲצֵרוֹתָ֑י כִּי־ בָחַ֨רְתִּי ב֥וֹ לִי֙ לְבֵ֔ן וַאֲנִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶה־ לּ֥וֹ לְאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lî šə·lō·mōh ḇin·ḵā hū- yiḇ·neh ḇê·ṯî wa·ḥă·ṣê·rō·w·ṯāy kî- ḇā·ḥar·tî ḇōw lî lə·ḇên wa·’ă·nî ’eh·yeh- lōw lə·’āḇ
verses.literal: And He said to me Solomon your son is the one who will build My house and My courts for I have chosen him as My son and I will be his Father
verses.literalPt: Disse-me: Teu filho Salomão edificará a minha casa e os meus átrios; porque o escolhi para ser meu filho e eu lhe serei pai.

verses.original: וַהֲכִינוֹתִ֥י אֶת־ מַלְכוּת֖וֹ עַד־ לְעוֹלָ֑ם אִם־ יֶחֱזַ֗ק לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת מִצְוֺתַ֥י וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯî ’eṯ- mal·ḵū·ṯōw ‘aḏ- lə·‘ō·w·lām ’im- ye·ḥĕ·zaq la·‘ă·śō·wṯ miṣ·wō·ṯay ū·miš·pā·ṭay kay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: I will establish his kingdom forever . . . if he resolutely carries out My commandments and ordinances as is being done this day
verses.literalPt: Estabelecerei o seu reino para sempre, se ele perseverar em cumprir os meus mandamentos e os meus juízos, como ele o faz no dia de hoje.

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּה לְעֵינֵ֨י כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל קְהַל־ יְהוָה֙ וּבְאָזְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ שִׁמְר֣וּ וְדִרְשׁ֔וּ כָּל־ מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽירְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה וְהִנְחַלְתֶּ֛ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֥ם אַחֲרֵיכֶ֖ם עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lə·‘ê·nê ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl qə·hal- Yah·weh ū·ḇə·’ā·zə·nê ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū šim·rū wə·ḏir·šū kāl- miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem lə·ma·‘an tî·rə·šū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh wə·hin·ḥal·tem liḇ·nê·ḵem ’a·ḥă·rê·ḵem ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: So now in the sight of all Israel the assembly of the LORD and in the hearing of our God keep and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God so that you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance to your descendants . . . forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora, à vista de todo o Israel, da congregação de Jeová e na audiência de nosso Deus, observai e buscai todos os mandamentos de Jeová, vosso Deus, para que possuais esta boa terra e a deixeis como herança para sempre a vossos filhos depois de vós.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה־ בְנִ֡י דַּע֩ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֨י אָבִ֜יךָ וְעָבְדֵ֗הוּ בְּלֵ֤ב שָׁלֵם֙ וּבְנֶ֣פֶשׁ חֲפֵצָ֔ה כִּ֤י כָל־ לְבָבוֹת֙ דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה וְכָל־ יֵ֥צֶר מַחֲשָׁב֖וֹת מֵבִ֑ין אִֽם־ תִּדְרְשֶׁ֙נּוּ֙ יִמָּ֣צֵא לָ֔ךְ וְאִם־ תַּֽעַזְבֶ֖נּוּ יַזְנִיחֲךָ֥ לָעַֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh šə·lō·mōh- ḇə·nî da‘ ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏê·hū bə·lêḇ šā·lêm ū·ḇə·ne·p̄eš ḥă·p̄ê·ṣāh kî ḵāl lə·ḇā·ḇō·wṯ dō·w·rêš Yah·weh wə·ḵāl yê·ṣer ma·ḥă·šā·ḇō·wṯ mê·ḇîn ’im- tiḏ·rə·šen·nū yim·mā·ṣê lāḵ wə·’im- ta·‘az·ḇen·nū yaz·nî·ḥă·ḵā lā·‘aḏ
verses.literal: As for you Solomon my son know the God of your father and serve Him wholeheartedly . . . and with a willing mind for the LORD searches every heart and understands the intent of every thought If you seek Him He will be found by you but if you forsake Him He will reject you forever
verses.literalPt: Tu, meu filho Salomão, conhece o Deus de teu pai e serve-o com um coração perfeito e uma plena vontade; porque Jeová esquadrinha todos os corações e entende todas as imaginações dos pensamentos. Se o buscares, será achado de ti; mas, se o deixares, rejeitar-te-á para sempre.

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה׀ עַתָּ֗ה כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֛ה בָּ֧חַר בְּךָ֛ לִבְנֽוֹת־ בַּ֥יִת לַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ חֲזַ֥ק וַעֲשֵֽׂה׃פ
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh ‘at·tāh kî- Yah·weh bā·ḥar bə·ḵā liḇ·nō·wṯ- ba·yiṯ lam·miq·dāš ḥă·zaq wa·‘ă·śêh
verses.literal: Consider now that the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary Be strong and do it
verses.literalPt: Toma cuidado, porque Jeová te escolheu para edificares uma casa para o santuário; esforça-te e faze-o.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן דָּוִ֣יד לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֡וֹ אֶת־ תַּבְנִ֣ית הָאוּלָם֩ וְֽאֶת־ בָּ֨תָּ֜יו וְגַנְזַכָּ֧יו וַעֲלִיֹּתָ֛יו וַחֲדָרָ֥יו הַפְּנִימִ֖ים וּבֵ֥ית הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên dā·wîḏ liš·lō·mōh ḇə·nōw ’eṯ- taḇ·nîṯ hā·’ū·lām wə·’eṯ- bāt·tāw wə·ḡan·zak·kāw wa·‘ă·lî·yō·ṯāw wa·ḥă·ḏā·rāw hap·pə·nî·mîm ū·ḇêṯ hak·kap·pō·reṯ
verses.literal: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the portico of the temple its buildings storehouses upper rooms inner rooms and the room for the mercy seat
verses.literalPt: Então, Davi deu a seu filho Salomão o modelo do pórtico do templo, com as suas casas, as suas tesourarias, os seus quartos superiores, as suas câmaras interiores e da casa do propiciatório;

verses.original: וְתַבְנִ֗ית כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה בָר֙וּחַ֙ עִמּ֔וֹ לְחַצְר֧וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֛ה וּלְכָל־ הַלְּשָׁכ֖וֹת סָבִ֑יב לְאֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּלְאֹצְר֖וֹת הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯaḇ·nîṯ kōl ’ă·šer hā·yāh ḇā·rū·aḥ ‘im·mōw lə·ḥaṣ·rō·wṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh ū·lə·ḵāl- hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ sā·ḇîḇ lə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·lə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ haq·qo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: The plans contained everything David had in mind for the courts of the house of the LORD for all the surrounding rooms for the treasuries of the house of God and of the dedicated things
verses.literalPt: também o modelo de tudo o que tinha na mente, com referência aos átrios da Casa de Jeová e a todas as câmaras ao redor, para os tesouros da Casa de Deus e para os tesouros das coisas sagradas;

verses.original: וּֽלְמַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם וּֽלְכָל־ מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֑ה וּֽלְכָל־ כְּלֵ֖י עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim ū·lə·ḵāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh ū·lə·ḵāl- kə·lê ‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: for the divisions of the priests and Levites for all the work of service in the house of the LORD and for all the articles of service in the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: também para as turmas dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, e para toda a obra do serviço da Casa de Jeová, e para todos os vasos do serviço na Casa de Jeová,

verses.original: לַזָּהָ֤ב בַּמִּשְׁקָל֙ לַזָּהָ֔ב לְכָל־ כְּלֵ֖י עֲבוֹדָ֣ה וַעֲבוֹדָ֑ה לְכֹ֨ל כְּלֵ֤י הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ בְּמִשְׁקָ֔ל לְכָל־ כְּלֵ֖י עֲבוֹדָ֥ה וַעֲבוֹדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: laz·zā·hāḇ bam·miš·qāl laz·zā·hāḇ lə·ḵāl kə·lê ‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏāh wa·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏāh lə·ḵōl kə·lê hak·ke·sep̄ bə·miš·qāl lə·ḵāl kə·lê ‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏāh wa·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏāh
verses.literal: the weight . . . of all the gold articles for every kind of service . . . the weight of all the silver articles for every kind . . . of service . . .
verses.literalPt: especificando o peso de ouro para os vasos de ouro, para todos os vasos de toda sorte de serviço; também o peso de prata para todos os vasos de prata para todos os vasos de toda sorte de serviço;

verses.original: וּמִשְׁקָ֞ל לִמְנֹר֣וֹת הַזָּהָ֗ב וְנֵרֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ זָהָ֔ב בְּמִשְׁקַל־ מְנוֹרָ֥ה וּמְנוֹרָ֖ה וְנֵרֹתֶ֑יהָ וְלִמְנֹר֨וֹת הַכֶּ֤סֶף בְּמִשְׁקָל֙ לִמְנוֹרָ֣ה וְנֵרֹתֶ֔יהָ כַּעֲבוֹדַ֖ת מְנוֹרָ֥ה וּמְנוֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·qāl lim·nō·rō·wṯ haz·zā·hāḇ wə·nê·rō·ṯê·hem zā·hāḇ bə·miš·qal- mə·nō·w·rāh ū·mə·nō·w·rāh wə·nê·rō·ṯe·hā wə·lim·nō·rō·wṯ hak·ke·sep̄ bə·miš·qāl lim·nō·w·rāh wə·nê·rō·ṯe·hā ka·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ mə·nō·w·rāh ū·mə·nō·w·rāh
verses.literal: the weight of the gold lampstands and their lamps including the weight of each lampstand . . . and its lamps the weight of each silver lampstand and its lamps according to the use of each lampstand . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: o peso para os candeeiros de ouro e para as suas lâmpadas, o peso de ouro para cada candeeiro e suas lâmpadas e para os candeeiros de prata, o peso de prata para cada candeeiro de prata e suas lâmpadas, segundo o uso de cada candeeiro;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָ֥ב מִשְׁקָ֛ל לְשֻׁלְחֲנ֥וֹת הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֖כֶת לְשֻׁלְחַ֣ן וְשֻׁלְחָ֑ן וְכֶ֖סֶף לְשֻׁלְחֲנ֥וֹת הַכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ miš·qāl lə·šul·ḥă·nō·wṯ ham·ma·‘ă·re·ḵeṯ lə·šul·ḥan wə·šul·ḥān wə·ḵe·sep̄ lə·šul·ḥă·nō·wṯ hak·kā·sep̄
verses.literal: the weight of gold for each table of showbread and of silver for the silver tables . . .
verses.literalPt: o peso de ouro para as mesas dos pães da proposição, para cada mesa; também a prata para as mesas de prata;

verses.original: וְהַמִּזְלָג֧וֹת וְהַמִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְהַקְּשָׂוֺ֖ת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וְלִכְפוֹרֵ֨י הַזָּהָ֤ב בְּמִשְׁקָל֙ לִכְפ֣וֹר וּכְפ֔וֹר וְלִכְפוֹרֵ֥י הַכֶּ֛סֶף בְּמִשְׁקָ֖ל לִכְפ֥וֹר וּכְפֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·miz·lā·ḡō·wṯ wə·ham·miz·rā·qō·wṯ wə·haq·qə·śā·wōṯ zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr wə·liḵ·p̄ō·w·rê haz·zā·hāḇ bə·miš·qāl liḵ·p̄ō·wr ū·ḵə·p̄ō·wr wə·liḵ·p̄ō·w·rê hak·ke·sep̄ bə·miš·qāl liḵ·p̄ō·wr ū·ḵə·p̄ō·wr
verses.literal: the weight of the pure gold for the forks sprinkling bowls and pitchers the weight of each gold dish . . . the weight . . . . . . of each silver bowl . . .
verses.literalPt: o ouro puro para os garfos, para as bacias e para os copos; para as taças de ouro especificou o peso de cada taça; para as taças de prata, o peso de cada taça;

verses.original: וּלְמִזְבַּ֧ח הַקְּטֹ֛רֶת זָהָ֥ב מְזֻקָּ֖ק בַּמִּשְׁקָ֑ל וּלְתַבְנִ֣ית הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֗ה הַכְּרֻבִ֤ים זָהָב֙ לְפֹ֣רְשִׂ֔ים וְסֹכְכִ֖ים עַל־ אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·miz·baḥ haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ zā·hāḇ mə·zuq·qāq bam·miš·qāl ū·lə·ṯaḇ·nîṯ ham·mer·kā·ḇāh hak·kə·ru·ḇîm zā·hāḇ lə·p̄ō·rə·śîm wə·sō·ḵə·ḵîm ‘al- ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: the weight of the refined gold for the altar of incense and the plans for the chariot of the gold cherubim that spread their wings and overshadowed . . . the ark of the covenant of the LORD
verses.literalPt: o peso de ouro refinado, para o altar do incenso; e o ouro, para o modelo do carro, os querubins que estendiam as suas asas e cobriam a arca da Aliança de Jeová.

verses.original: הַכֹּ֥ל בִּכְתָ֛ב מִיַּ֥ד יְהוָ֖ה עָלַ֣י הִשְׂכִּ֑יל כֹּ֖ל מַלְאֲכ֥וֹת הַתַּבְנִֽית׃פ
verses.transliteration: hak·kōl biḵ·ṯāḇ mî·yaḏ Yah·weh ‘ā·lay hiś·kîl kōl mal·’ă·ḵō·wṯ hat·taḇ·nîṯ
verses.literal: All this,” said David all the details of this plan the LORD has made clear to me in writing by His hand upon me
verses.literalPt: É por uma escrita da sua mão, disse Davi, que Jeová me revelou tudo isso, todas as obras do modelo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֗וֹ חֲזַ֤ק וֶאֱמַץ֙ וַעֲשֵׂ֔ה אַל־ תִּירָ֖א וְאַל־ תֵּחָ֑ת כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֱלֹהַי֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֤א יַרְפְּךָ֙ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֔ךָּ עַד־ לִכְל֕וֹת כָּל־ מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ liš·lō·mōh ḇə·nōw ḥă·zaq we·’ĕ·maṣ wa·‘ă·śêh ’al- tî·rā wə·’al- tê·ḥāṯ kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ĕ·lō·hay ‘im·māḵ lō yar·pə·ḵā wə·lō ya·‘az·ḇe·kā ‘aḏ- liḵ·lō·wṯ kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: David also said to Solomon his son Be strong and courageous and do it Do not be afraid . . . or discouraged for the LORD God my God is with you He will neither fail you . . . nor forsake you before all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished
verses.literalPt: Disse Davi a seu filho Salomão: Esforça-te, e tem bom ânimo, e mete mãos à obra. Não tenhas medo, nem te desalentes, porque Jeová Deus, meu Deus, é contigo, e não te faltará, nem te abandonará, até que seja acabada toda a obra para o serviço da Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֗ה מַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְכָל־ עֲבוֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעִמְּךָ֙ בְכָל־ מְלָאכָ֜ה לְכָל־ נָדִ֤יב בַּֽחָכְמָה֙ לְכָל־ עֲבוֹדָ֔ה וְהַשָּׂרִ֥ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם לְכָל־ דְּבָרֶֽיךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim lə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·‘im·mə·ḵā ḇə·ḵāl- mə·lā·ḵāh lə·ḵāl nā·ḏîḇ ba·ḥā·ḵə·māh lə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏāh wə·haś·śā·rîm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām lə·ḵāl də·ḇā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the service of the house of God and every willing man of every skill will be at your disposal for the work The officials and all . . . the people . . . are fully at your command
verses.literalPt: Eis as turmas dos sacerdotes e dos levitas para todo o serviço da Casa de Deus; e estará contigo em toda sorte de obra todo homem bem disposto e perito para qualquer sorte de serviço. Também os capitães e todo o povo estarão inteiramente às tuas ordens.
